# Poland golden fixtures (ZP-PL-ENG-001 Phase 3)

Hand-computed expected results for the Poland engine. Every figure is worked out in
the fixture's `hand` list from the poland_content values plus the TEST fixtures in
`tests/_pl_engine_helpers.py` (rounding rules, cost caps, PIT-0 limit, health limitation,
employer-PPK PIT treatment, FP/FS minimum-base and fund-cap rules) - the points the
specification leaves to gate G1.

These are NOT the AC-PL-02 certification fixtures: those must be official or
independently prepared 2026 examples, signed at G1, with the signed policy values
replacing the TEST ones.
